dm_autoDeleteSoon: within the next hour, if it stays unused
dm_defaultHint: Default model of the instance. It is never deleted automatically.
dm_deleteConfirm: Delete %s? This frees %s on the disk. The model can be downloaded again at any time.
dm_deleteConfirmDefault: %s is the default model. Delete it anyway? This frees %s on the disk, but the model is downloaded again at the next start of the instance.
dm_downloadHint: Download a model from the Ollama library
dm_modelHelp: A suggestion from the list or any name from ollama.com/library, e.g. qwen3:1.7b
dm_totalSizeHint: Disk space used by all downloaded models
help_autoUpdate: Pulls a newer image of ollama/ollama when available and recreates the container
help_bind: 0.0.0.0 makes the server reachable in the whole network without any password. Keep 127.0.0.1 if only this host uses it.
help_defaultModel: Used for requests that do not name a model. A model that is not downloaded yet (without ✓) is downloaded when the instance starts. It needs about as much free memory as its size, plus 1-2 GB.
help_deleteUnusedDays: 0 = never. A model counts as used while it is loaded or answers a request. The default model is never deleted. Use while the instance is stopped is not seen.
help_externalUrl: Address of a running Ollama server, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434
help_gpu: ROCm needs an AMD graphics card and the devices /dev/kfd and /dev/dri on the host
help_keepAlive: How long a model stays loaded after the last request, e.g. 5m, 1h, 0 (unload immediately) or -1 (forever)
help_keepDefaultLoaded: The default model is loaded when the instance starts and stays in memory, so it answers at once. If another model was used, it is loaded again afterwards. It uses its memory all the time.
help_maxQueue: Requests beyond this number are rejected immediately with an error
help_parallel: How many requests are sent to the model at the same time. Further requests wait in the queue.
help_requestTimeout: Maximum duration of a single request to the model
help_stopOnUnload: If disabled, the loaded model stays in memory when the adapter restarts
